note: D1 the one surge rule, negative half: sap_snare is cost 1 and carries only the default {cost: -1}, which cannot lower a cost-1 price, so casting it from growth is not a surge - no verdant, no surge event, and the tile is still standing. The grow_spike cast right after it on the same turn is the proof: it surges on that same tile (verdant (1,3), keys [dmg], 3 + 1 = 4). The pre-D1 rule left the tile alone too (a cost-1 cast never consumed growth); what D1 adds is that the cost-1 grow_spike beside it now does eat it
